noncomputable def VTask.binaryRec {motive : ℕ → Sort u} (zero : motive 0) (bit : Bool → ℕ → motive n → motive (Nat.bit b n)) (n : ℕ) : motive n :=
  match n with
  | 0 => zero
  | Nat.succ m =>
    let b := Nat.testBit m 0
    let n' := Nat.shiftRight m 1
    bit b n' (VTask.binaryRec zero bit n')
